<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/bootstrap.php';
require_role('owner_admin');

header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');

function miv_api_json(int $status, array $payload): void
{
    if ($status >= 400 && db()->inTransaction()) db()->rollBack();
    http_response_code($status);
    echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

function miv_api_order_row(int $orderId): ?array
{
    $stmt = db()->prepare("
        SELECT o.*,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.component='products' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS products_paid,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.component='shipping' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS shipping_paid,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.component='general' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS general_paid,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS paid_total
        FROM miv_shipping_orders o
        LEFT JOIN miv_shipping_payments p ON p.order_id=o.id
        WHERE o.id=?
        GROUP BY o.id
        LIMIT 1
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$orderId]);
    $row = $stmt->fetch();
    if (!$row) return null;
    $row['products_outstanding'] = max(0, round((float)$row['products_total'] - (float)$row['products_paid'],2));
    $row['shipping_outstanding'] = max(0, round((float)$row['shipping_total'] - (float)$row['shipping_paid'],2));
    $row['outstanding_total'] = max(0, round((float)$row['total_amount'] - (float)$row['paid_total'],2));
    $row['quote_type'] = miv_quote_type($row);
    return $row;
}



function miv_quote_type(array $order): string {
    $quote = json_decode($order['quote_json'] ?? '{}', true);
    return ($quote['quoteType'] ?? '') === 'delivery_only' ? 'delivery_only' : 'goods_delivery';
}

function miv_budget_owner(): int {
    $owner = (int)(current_user()['id'] ?? 0);
    if ($owner < 1) miv_api_json(401, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Please sign in again.']);
    return $owner;
}

function miv_budget_table(): void {
    db()->exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS miv_budgets (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
        starts_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', ends_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        available_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, planned_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
        actual_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, categories_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )");
}

function miv_budget_text($value, int $max, string $label): string {
    if (!is_string($value) || strlen($value) > $max || strpos($value, "\0") !== false)
        miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Check the '.$label.'.']);
    return trim($value);
}

function miv_budget_cents($value): int {
    // Accept decimal currency strings; never silently round or coerce malformed amounts.
    if (!is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^\d{1,7}(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/D', $value))
        miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Enter amounts from 0 to 9,999,999.99 with up to two decimal places.']);
    $parts = explode('.', $value, 2);
    return (int)$parts[0] * 100 + (int)str_pad($parts[1] ?? '', 2, '0');
}

function miv_budget_date($value): string {
    if ($value === '') return '';
    if (!is_string($value)) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Check the budget dates.']);
    $date = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value);
    if (!$date || $date->format('Y-m-d') !== $value)
        miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Check the budget dates.']);
    return $value;
}

function miv_budget_row(array $row): array {
    foreach (['available_cents','planned_cents','actual_cents','version'] as $field) $row[$field] = (int)$row[$field];
    if (isset($row['categories_json'])) {
        $row['categories'] = json_decode($row['categories_json'], true);
        unset($row['categories_json']);
    }
    return $row;
}

function miv_budget_get(string $id, int $owner): ?array {
    $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM miv_budgets WHERE id=? AND owner_id=?');
    $stmt->execute([$id,$owner]);
    $row = $stmt->fetch();
    return $row ? miv_budget_row($row) : null;
}

 $cols=function(){return array_column(db()->query("PRAGMA table_info(miv_wallet_entries)")->fetchAll(),"name");};
 if(array_diff(["shop","description"],$cols())){db()->exec("BEGIN IMMEDIATE");try{foreach(array_diff(["shop","description"],$cols()) as $col) db()->exec("ALTER TABLE miv_wallet_entries ADD COLUMN ".$col." TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''");db()->exec("COMMIT");}catch(Throwable $e){db()->exec("ROLLBACK");throw $e;}}
}
function miv_entry_save(array $in): void {
 $owner=miv_budget_owner();$id=miv_budget_text($in['id']??'',80,'entry ID');$kind=$in['kind']??'';$cat=miv_budget_text($in['category']??'',160,'category');$day=miv_budget_date($in['day']??'');$amt=miv_budget_cents($in['amount']??'');
 if(!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,80}$/D',$id)||!in_array($kind,['income','expense'],true)||!$cat||!$day||!$amt)miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Choose a category, date and positive amount.']);
 $shop=preg_replace('/\s+/u',' ',miv_budget_text($in['shop']??'',320,'shop'));$desc=miv_budget_text($in['description']??'',1600,'description');
 miv_entry_table();db()->prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO miv_wallet_entries(owner_id,id,kind,category,day,cents,shop,description) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)')->execute([$owner,$id,$kind,$cat,$day,$amt,$shop,$desc]);
 $s=db()->prepare('SELECT * FROM miv_wallet_entries WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?');$s->execute([$owner,$id]);$v=$s->fetch();
 if($v['shop']!==$shop||$v['description']!==$desc||$v['day']!==$day||$v['kind']!==$kind||$v['category']!==$cat||(int)$v['cents']!==$amt)miv_api_json(409,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Entry already saved with different details.']);
 miv_api_json(200,['ok'=>true,'entry'=>$v]);
}
function miv_budget_read(string $mode): void {
    $owner = miv_budget_owner();
    miv_budget_table();
    if ($mode === 'budget_get') {
        $row = miv_budget_get((string)($_GET['id'] ?? ''), $owner);
        if (!$row) miv_api_json(404, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Budget not found.']);
        miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'budget'=>$row]);
    }
    $stmt = db()->prepare('SELECT id,name,starts_on,ends_on,available_cents,planned_cents,actual_cents,version,created_at,updated_at FROM miv_budgets WHERE owner_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id');
    $stmt->execute([$owner]);
    $entries=[];$month=$_GET['month']??'';if(is_string($month)&&preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/D',$month)){miv_entry_table();$q=db()->prepare('SELECT id,day,kind,category,cents,shop,description FROM miv_wallet_entries WHERE owner_id=? AND day LIKE ? ORDER BY day DESC,rowid DESC');$q->execute([$owner,$month.'-%']);$entries=$q->fetchAll();}
    miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'entries'=>$entries,'budgets'=>array_map('miv_budget_row', $stmt->fetchAll())]);
}

function miv_budget_save(array $input): void {
    $owner = miv_budget_owner();
    $id = miv_budget_text($input['id'] ?? '', 80, 'budget ID');
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,80}$/D', $id)) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Start a new budget and try again.']);
    $version = $input['version'] ?? null;
    if (!is_int($version) || $version < 0) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Reopen the saved budget before editing.']);
    $name = miv_budget_text($input['name'] ?? '', 240, 'budget name');
    if ($name === '') miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Give your budget a name.']);
    $start = miv_budget_date($input['starts_on'] ?? '');
    $end = miv_budget_date($input['ends_on'] ?? '');
    if ($start !== '' && $end !== '' && $start > $end) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'End date must be on or after the start date.']);
    $notes = miv_budget_text($input['notes'] ?? '', 4000, 'notes');
    $available = miv_budget_cents($input['available'] ?? '');
    $categories = $input['categories'] ?? null;
    if (!is_array($categories) || count($categories) < 1 || count($categories) > 100)
        miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Add between 1 and 100 spending categories.']);
    $clean = []; $planned = 0; $actual = 0;
    foreach ($categories as $category) {
        if (!is_array($category)) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Check the spending categories.']);
        $label = miv_budget_text($category['name'] ?? '', 160, 'category name');
        if ($label === '') miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Name every spending category.']);
        $p = miv_budget_cents($category['planned'] ?? '');
        $a = miv_budget_cents($category['actual'] ?? '');
        $planned += $p; $actual += $a;
        $clean[] = ['name'=>$label,'planned_cents'=>$p,'actual_cents'=>$a];
    }
    $json = json_encode($clean, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    if ($json === false) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Use valid text for the spending categories.']);
    miv_budget_table();
    db()->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
    $existing = miv_budget_get($id, $owner);
    if ($existing && $existing['name'] === $name && $existing['starts_on'] === $start && $existing['ends_on'] === $end && $existing['available_cents'] === $available && $existing['notes'] === $notes && $existing['categories'] === $clean && $existing['version'] === $version + 1) {
        // Safe retry after a successful save whose response was lost.
        db()->exec('COMMIT');
        miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'budget'=>$existing]);
    }
    if (($existing && $existing['version'] !== $version) || (!$existing && $version !== 0))
        miv_api_json(409, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'This budget changed on another device. Your edits are still here. Reopen the latest saved version or save your edits as a new budget.']);
    if ($existing) {
        db()->prepare('UPDATE miv_budgets SET name=?,starts_on=?,ends_on=?,available_cents=?,planned_cents=?,actual_cents=?,categories_json=?,notes=?,version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=? AND owner_id=?')->execute([$name,$start,$end,$available,$planned,$actual,$json,$notes,$id,$owner]);
    } else {
        $collision = db()->prepare('SELECT 1 FROM miv_budgets WHERE id=?');
        $collision->execute([$id]);
        if ($collision->fetchColumn()) miv_api_json(409, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Please save this as a new budget.']);
        db()->prepare('INSERT INTO miv_budgets (id,owner_id,name,starts_on,ends_on,available_cents,planned_cents,actual_cents,categories_json,notes,version) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1)')->execute([$id,$owner,$name,$start,$end,$available,$planned,$actual,$json,$notes]);
    }
    $saved = miv_budget_get($id, $owner);
    db()->exec('COMMIT');
    miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'budget'=>$saved]);
}


if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'GET') {
    $mode = (string)($_GET['mode'] ?? 'list');
    if (in_array($mode, ['budget_list','budget_get'], true)) miv_budget_read($mode);
    if ($mode === 'payments') {
        $orderId = (int)($_GET['order_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($orderId < 1) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Order ID required.']);
        $stmt = db()->prepare("SELECT * FROM miv_shipping_payments WHERE order_id=? ORDER BY paid_at DESC,id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([$orderId]);
        miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'payments'=>$stmt->fetchAll()]);
    }

    $rows = db()->query("
        SELECT o.*,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.component='products' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS products_paid,
               COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.component='shipping' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS shipping_paid,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS paid_total
        FROM miv_shipping_orders o
        LEFT JOIN miv_shipping_payments p ON p.order_id=o.id
        GROUP BY o.id
        ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC,o.id DESC

    ")->fetchAll();
    foreach ($rows as &$row) {
        $row['quote_type'] = miv_quote_type($row);
        $row['products_outstanding'] = max(0, round((float)$row['products_total'] - (float)$row['products_paid'],2));
        $row['shipping_outstanding'] = max(0, round((float)$row['shipping_total'] - (float)$row['shipping_paid'],2));
        $row['outstanding_total'] = max(0, round((float)$row['total_amount'] - (float)$row['paid_total'],2));
    }
    unset($row);
    miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'orders'=>$rows]);
}

$csrf = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_X_MIV_CSRF'] ?? '');
$expected = (string)($_SESSION['miv_shipping_csrf'] ?? '');
if ($expected === '' || $csrf === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $csrf)) {
    miv_api_json(403, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Your session token expired. Refresh and try again.']);
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') miv_api_json(405,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'POST required.']);
$input = json_decode((string)file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if (!is_array($input)) $input = $_POST;
$action = (string)($input['action'] ?? '');
$user = current_user();
if ($action === 'wallet_entry') miv_entry_save($input);
if ($action === 'budget_save') miv_budget_save($input);

if ($action === 'create_order') {
    $quote = $input['quote'] ?? null;
    if (!is_array($quote)) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Quote data is required.']);
    $reference = trim((string)($quote['reference'] ?? ''));
    $customer = trim((string)($quote['customer'] ?? ''));
    if ($reference === '' || $customer === '') miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Quote reference and customer are required.']);

    $type = $quote['quoteType'] ?? 'goods_delivery';
    if (!in_array($type,['goods_delivery','delivery_only'],true)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Choose a valid quote type.']);
    $deliveryOnly = $type === 'delivery_only';
    $quote['quoteType'] = $type;
    $products = round((float)($quote['itemsNad'] ?? 0), 2);
    $shipping = round((float)($quote['shippingTotal'] ?? 0), 2);
    $total = round((float)($quote['total'] ?? ($products + $shipping)), 2);
    $weight = round((float)($quote['totalWeight'] ?? 0), 3);
    $plan = in_array(($input['payment_plan'] ?? ''), ['full','split','custom'], true) ? (string)$input['payment_plan'] : 'split';
    if ($deliveryOnly) $plan = 'custom';
    $initialStage = $plan === 'split' ? 'awaiting_product_payment' : 'awaiting_payment';

    if ($deliveryOnly) $initialStage = 'accepted';
    $existing=db()->prepare('SELECT id FROM miv_shipping_orders WHERE quote_reference=?');
    $existing->execute([$reference]);
    if($existing->fetchColumn()) miv_api_json(409,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'This quote reference already has an order. Open it in Orders & Payments.']);
    if(!is_finite($products) || !is_finite($shipping) || !is_finite($total) || !is_finite($weight) || ($deliveryOnly ? ($products != 0 || $shipping <= 0) : $products <= 0) || $shipping < 0 || $weight <= 0 || (int)round($total*100)!==(int)round(($products+$shipping)*100) || $total>100000000) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Quote totals are invalid.']);
    $stmt = db()->prepare("
        INSERT INTO miv_shipping_orders
        (quote_reference,customer_name,phone,products_total,shipping_total,total_amount,total_weight,payment_plan,order_stage,quote_json,created_by,created_by_name)
        VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?, ?,?,?)
    ");
    $stmt->execute([
        $reference,$customer,trim((string)($quote['phone'] ?? '')) ?: null,
        $products,$shipping,$total,$weight,$plan,$initialStage,json_encode($quote, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
        (int)($user['id'] ?? 0) ?: null,(string)($user['name'] ?? '')
    ]);
    $id = (int)db()->lastInsertId();
    if ($id < 1) {
        $q = db()->prepare("SELECT id FROM miv_shipping_orders WHERE quote_reference=? LIMIT 1");
        $q->execute([$reference]);
        $id = (int)$q->fetchColumn();
    }
    miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'order'=>miv_api_order_row($id)]);
}

if ($action === 'update_order') {
    $id = (int)($input['order_id'] ?? 0);
    if ($id < 1) miv_api_json(400, ['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Order ID required.']);
    $stage = trim((string)($input['order_stage'] ?? ''));
    $plan = trim((string)($input['payment_plan'] ?? ''));
    $allowedStages = ['accepted','awaiting_payment','awaiting_product_payment','products_paid','paid','ordered_china','china_warehouse','in_transit_sa','in_south_africa','awaiting_shipping_payment','shipping_paid','in_transit_namibia','ready','completed','cancelled'];
    if (!in_array($stage,$allowedStages,true)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Choose a valid order stage.']);
    if (!in_array($plan,['full','split','custom'],true)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Choose a valid payment plan.']);
    $existingOrder=miv_api_order_row($id);
    if (!$existingOrder) miv_api_json(404,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Order not found.']);
    if ($existingOrder['quote_type']==='delivery_only') {
        if(in_array($stage,['awaiting_product_payment','products_paid','ordered_china'],true)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Delivery-only orders skip product purchasing stages.']);
        $plan='custom';
    }
    $stmt = db()->prepare("UPDATE miv_shipping_orders SET order_stage=?,payment_plan=?,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=?");
    $stmt->execute([$stage,$plan,$id]);
    miv_api_json(200, ['ok'=>true,'order'=>miv_api_order_row($id)]);
}

if ($action === 'record_payment') {
    $id = (int)($input['order_id'] ?? 0);
    $amount = round((float)($input['amount'] ?? 0),2);
    $component = (string)($input['component'] ?? 'general');
    $method = trim((string)($input['payment_method'] ?? ''));
    $date = trim((string)($input['paid_at'] ?? ''));
    $note = trim((string)($input['note'] ?? ''));
    if ($id < 1 || !is_finite($amount) || $amount <= 0) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Enter a valid payment amount.']);
    if (!in_array($component,['products','shipping','general'],true)) $component='general';
    if (!preg_match('/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/',$date)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Enter a valid payment date.']);

    $requestId=(string)($input['request_id']??'');
    if(!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,100}$/',$requestId)) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Payment request ID required.']);
    db()->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
    $seen=db()->prepare('SELECT order_id FROM miv_shipping_payments WHERE request_id=?');$seen->execute([$requestId]);$seenId=$seen->fetchColumn();
    if($seenId){if((int)$seenId!==$id)miv_api_json(409,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Payment reference belongs to another order.']);db()->exec('COMMIT');miv_api_json(200,['ok'=>true,'order'=>miv_api_order_row((int)$seenId)]);}
    $parsedDate=DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d',$date);
    if(!$parsedDate || $parsedDate->format('Y-m-d')!==$date) miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Enter a valid payment date.']);
    $before = miv_api_order_row($id);
    if (!$before) miv_api_json(404,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Order not found.']);
    if ($before['quote_type']==='delivery_only' && $component==='products') miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Record a shipping payment for this delivery-only order.']);
    $limit = (float)$before['outstanding_total'];
    if ($component === 'products') $limit = (float)$before['products_outstanding'];
    if ($component === 'shipping') $limit = (float)$before['shipping_outstanding'];
    if ((int)round($amount*100) > (int)round($limit*100)) {
        miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Payment is greater than the outstanding amount for this section.']);
    }

    $insert = db()->prepare("INSERT INTO miv_shipping_payments(order_id,component,amount,payment_method,paid_at,note,created_by,created_by_name,request_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)");
    $actorId = (int)($user['id']??0) ?: null;
    $actorName = (string)($user['name']??'');
    if ($component === 'general') {
        $remaining = $amount;
        $productPart = min($remaining, (float)$before['products_outstanding']);
        if ($productPart > 0.009) {
            $insert->execute([$id,'products',$productPart,$method?:null,$date,$note?:null,$actorId,$actorName,$requestId]);
            $remaining = round($remaining - $productPart, 2);
        }
        $shippingPart = min($remaining, (float)$before['shipping_outstanding']);
        if ($shippingPart > 0.009) {
            $insert->execute([$id,'shipping',$shippingPart,$method?:null,$date,$note?:null,$actorId,$actorName,$requestId]);
            $remaining = round($remaining - $shippingPart, 2);
        }
        if ($remaining > 0.009) {
            miv_api_json(400,['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Payment could not be allocated to the remaining order balance.']);
        }
    } else {
        $insert->execute([$id,$component,$amount,$method?:null,$date,$note?:null,$actorId,$actorName,$requestId]);
    }

    $order = miv_api_order_row($id);
    if ($order) {
        $newStage = $order['order_stage'];
        if ($order['quote_type']==='delivery_only') {
